# Global Spirit Group — Virtual Office & Open V3 AI Ecosystem

> Autonomous multi-agent command center, Director NLU orchestration (`@unitybusinessbot`), Open V3 AI Store Builder, and Traffic & Direct Booking suite by Global Spirit Group / Global Team Partners.

## Core Platforms

- [Global Spirit Group Virtual Office (RU)](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/): Unified AI Virtual Office with Antigravity 2.31 Hydrogen orchestration, Telegram bot mesh, project workspaces, and autonomous SEO autopilot.
- [Global Spirit Group Virtual Office (EN)](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/index_en.html): English edition of the Virtual Office control panel and autonomous agent board.
- [Open V3 AI Store Builder](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/ai_store_builder/): Launch an AI-generated Shopify storefront and Telegram Mini App bundle in 15 minutes.
- [Traffic & Direct Booking Engine](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/Traffic/): Exponential organic traffic, direct booking funnel optimization, and AI analytics suite.
- [12 IT Products in 12 Months](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/12_IT_Products/): Rapid Telegram Mini App product factory and monetization pipeline.
- [AI Skills & Macroeconomic Stabilization Suite](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/AI_Skills_And_Macro_Stabilization/): Applied AI agent skill packs and strategic financial modeling tools.
- [GlobalFilms](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/globalfilms/): Production equipment catalog and filmmaker workflow platform.
- [Unity Office App Installer](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/Unity_Office_App_Installer.html): Cross-platform PWA installation guide for desktop and mobile teams.
- [Live Agent Command Graph](https://globalteampartners.github.io/remote-agents-control/agents_live/): Real-time interactive hierarchy graph showing Owner → `@unitybusinessbot` → Director Tim → Subordinate AI Agents & SEO autopilot tasks.

## Associated Brand Domains

- [Global Plus Tech](https://globalplus.tech): Technology solutions and digital product engineering.
- [Unity Spirit Partners](https://unityspiritpartners.com): Global business partnership, relocation, and AI advisory ecosystem.
